title: How a Doorbell Camera Works in 60 Seconds 🔔📹 #shorts
description:
A doorbell camera knows you're there before you press the button. A passive infrared sensor spots body heat and tells the camera to start recording, while a wide lens sees up to 180 degrees. The clip travels over Wi-Fi to your phone, with two-way audio and infrared night vision. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#doorbellcamera #smarthome #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A doorbell camera can see you *before* you ring, across up to *180 degrees*.

steps.label: Heat
steps.text: A *PIR sensor* watches for *infrared* heat from a person walking up.

steps.label: Record
steps.text: When the heat pattern changes, it signals the *camera* to start recording.

steps.label: Wi-Fi
steps.text: The video travels over *Wi-Fi* and an *alert* pops up on your phone.

steps.label: Talk
steps.text: A *microphone* and *speaker* let you talk to the visitor from anywhere.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: In the dark, *infrared LEDs* light the scene in black and white, invisible to us.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Sense, record, *alert*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
